one_line: A bold one-line reframe of how letters are taught, in text on frame one, over the product in use.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 top-down on a classroom table: pizza-shaped letter boards, loose paper slices, a box in the corner, a young child's torso. Text: "ילדים לא משתעממים מלמוד אותיות הם משתעממים מהדרך שבה מלמדים אותן". No speech.
q1_hook.why: A headline in frame one reframes a known problem, so a parent or teacher gets the point at once (T3, H1). A child's hand moves a slice by 0:01, so it is not a still (E1). But the product name and what the game gives only come at 0:05, and nothing is spoken (H2, H6).

beats.what: Claim text over the table of pizza boards and loose slices; a child's hand moves a slice
beats.why: States the problem while something moves

beats.what: Child's hands match picture slices (bike, rabbit, watermelon) onto the letter boards; second card at 0:05
beats.why: Answers the claim: they play, they learn

beats.what: Laminated worksheet of pictures; a child circles pictures with blue then red markers, no text
beats.why: A second activity, one long shot

beats.what: Rows of finished boards, then the box front close up; "לפרטים על הערכה שלחו לי הודעה"
beats.why: Product name appears with the ask

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: A DM ask only: on screen at 0:20 and in the caption, "שלחו לי הודעה". No comment question, share, save or tag prompt.
q2_flow.why: The claim opens a gap that the matching game answers at 0:05 (H5). But only 4 shots in 23 s, with a 9 s stretch of one worksheet activity and no new information, slows the middle (R3, R1). The box is held back to the end. Length suits a short demo (R2).

q3_cta.what: On screen 0:20 to 0:23: "לפרטים על הערכה שלחו לי הודעה 🩷". Caption, last text line: "לפרטים על הערכה, שלחו לי הודעה 💌". Nothing spoken. No price, no keyword.
q3_cta.why: One ask, repeated on screen and in the caption (C1, C6). It comes after the product is shown, at the very end. But the text sits in the lower middle, inside the bottom 35%, and a generic "send a message" with no keyword or price adds friction (C6, C3).

q4_shown.what: Pizza-shaped letter boards and loose slices from 0:00; a child's hands placing picture slices on boards 0:03 to 0:11; a laminated worksheet circled with markers 0:11 to 0:20; rows of finished boards, then the box front "פיצת האותיות" at 0:20. No price, no face.
q4_shown.why: The game is on the table and handled by 0:01 (S1, K5). Only hands and a torso are shown, so no child's face is needed (S4, S5). The brand name is held back until 0:05 in text and 0:21 on the box, so the product is shown early but named late (H3).

q5_edit.what: 4 shots in 23 s, about 5.7 s each; hard cuts at 4.7, 11.2 and 20.4 s; handheld, no speed changes. Three text cards: 0:00 to 0:03, 0:05 to 0:10, 0:20 to 0:23, none between 0:10 and 0:20. No speech. Ends on the box front.
q5_edit.why: Few cuts and handheld shots keep a slow, calm pace (E2). The message is only in text, no audio: fine muted, empty with sound on (E4). The first claim card shows about 3 s, a little short for its length (T5). It stops right on the CTA (E8).

q6_topic.what: A letter-learning game kit: pizza boards for Hebrew letters matched with picture slices, a worksheet; serves a parent or gan teacher who wants playful letter practice.
q6_topic.why: Learning letters is a real parent concern and the reframe speaks to it (K6). "בלי להרגיש שהם בכלל לומדים" is a mild developmental claim, stated as fact (K4). No joy or surprise peak, and no gifting or occasion moment (K1, K7).

q7_filmed.what: Handheld phone above a classroom table, in daylight: wide top-down on the boards, closer on a child's hands matching slices, close-up of a laminated sheet being marked, then the box close to the lens. A child's torso, no face.
q7_filmed.why: Top-down hands show the game being used (F5). Boards are small in the opening wide shot but readable once closer, and the worksheet fills the frame (F4). A handheld, classroom setting looks like a real creator, not an ad (H8, F7).

q8_text.on_screen: White bold text with a black outline, centred, lower middle: 0:00 "ילדים לא משתעממים מלמוד אותיות הם משתעממים מהדרך שבה מלמדים אותן" (4 lines); 0:05 "עם פיצת האותיות הם משחקים, נהנים ולומדים אותיות בלי להרגיש שהם בכלל לומדים" (5 lines); 0:20 "לפרטים על הערכה שלחו לי הודעה 🩷". No text 0:10 to 0:20.
q8_text.caption: "פיצת האותיות 🍕". About 27 words: the product, one benefit line, "לפרטים על הערכה, שלחו לי הודעה 💌", 4 hashtags (#גןילדים #פעילותלילדים #גננות #ילדים). No question, no disclosure line (her own kit, not verified).
q8_text.why: A claim card at 0:00 is the right idea (T3), but it is a full sentence of about 65 characters (T2, T5). Cards two and three sit in the bottom 35% (T4). The caption's first line is the product name in plain keywords, with only 4, partly generic, hashtags (T7).

weak_points: A long claim shown for about 3 s; product name only at 0:05, box only at 0:20; text in the bottom band; a generic DM ask with no keyword or price; no reaction or result as proof.
lumebook_takeaway: Lay the book on a table, film top-down hands only, put a one-line claim in the first second, and a title card plus DM ask in the last 3 s.
not_verified: Whether it is her own product or a reseller kit (the box reads "פיצרייה לילדים"). Music (transcript only "תודה רבה", no speech evident). The kit's price. The child's exact age and whether the setting is a gan or school. No corrections to the coded file, which matched the frames.
